text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Fourteen people assassinated in "cowardly way" in Tabainat village, in Blida province, but it is absolutely sure the Algerian people will continue a merciless struggle against this blind terrorism.
- Government sets up a task-force to streamline bureaucracy following presidential order number 10.
- Fourteen people, from three families, killed in Tabainat village and five girls murdered in Chebli hamlet.
- Joint committees, grouping government and workers' union officials, work on salaries and collective conventions.
- A "terrorist" ringleader killed in the western town of Mostaganem.
- University teachers resume courses after strike over pay.
- The Transitional National Council debates a party law to implement a constitution ban on political parties based on religious principles.
